laws.conservation: Matter, energy, biological capacity, information, and CM require an origin, transfer, conversion, or depletion event.
laws.causality: Every state change requires a recorded cause.
laws.persistence: State changes remain until later events modify them.
laws.limited_information: Characters know only what they observed, were told, inferred, or accessed legitimately.
laws.scalable_resolution: Simulation fidelity changes with relevance without rewriting outcomes.
